name: ox-cli-decision
description: Consult team context BEFORE creating or editing a Decision Record (ADR, DDR, architecture/design decision doc). Auto-fire when the user asks to "write an ADR", "add a decision record", "amend/update ADR-NNN", cites a DR by number, or edits a file under docs/adr/ or docs/decisions/. Run `ox decision enrich --topic "<subject>"` before drafting a new DR and `ox decision enrich --file <dr.md>` before editing an existing one — related decisions, numbering, conventions, drift, and ready-to-paste citations at zero LLM cost. Follow the returned `guidance`.
